fallbacks.title: Platform defaults for uncovered controls
fallbacks.statement: If the system defines no control for a need, use the platform's native element restyled to the field language (tint ground, #c9c9c9 lines, 4px radius, ink text); keep native semantics.
constraints: mark the improvisation and file a gap if it recurs

fallbacks.title: No-JS fallback (noscript stylesheet)
fallbacks.statement: Without JavaScript, the load-in is skipped and content renders immediately (noscript.css lifts the is-preload state).
constraints: menu degrades to in-page anchor (undefined beyond that)

fallbacks.title: Light ground only
fallbacks.statement: No dark mode is defined; dark contexts are outside this authority (undecided, not declined).
constraints: file a gap if a dark requirement appears
